purpose: Independent initialization cohort of five seeds per objective for correspondence-selection replication
scope: Second independently initialized cohort conditional on exactly the same GPT2 model, natural documents/order, SAE objective/hyperparameters and 16M-token schedule as R19. Five seeds11-15 per objective; checkpoint recording is reduced to4M/16M but training is otherwise identical. This samples initialization randomness, not new training data or base-model randomness. Same fixed validation and exact final optimizer state; no paid resources or official-test use.
